newsitem.title: FINLAND: POSTIPANKKI TO CLOSE BANK SERVICE AT 214 OUTLETS.
newsitem.headline: POSTIPANKKI TO CLOSE BANK SERVICE AT 214 OUTLETS.

text.p: Finnish state-owned Postipankki Oy and Suomen Posti Oy said on Thursday Postipankki's banking services will be halted at 214 post branches in 1997 and 1998.
"Bank services will be available in 540 bank or post branches at the end of 1998," the companies said in a joint statement.
They said Postipankki has already this year stopped bank services at 237 post branches.
The bank will also close 18 of its own branches in the next few months, the companies said. The changes mean that 1,300 jobs will be cut by the end of 1998, they said.
